title: 5 Bitcoin Gift Ideas (From Lottery Miners to Sats)
hook: Five Bitcoin gift ideas that are more than socks.

scenes.narration: A Bitaxe is an open-source miner that runs quietly on a desk. Treat it as a lottery ticket, not income.
A dedicated device that keeps private keys offline. The seed phrase stays the master backup.
One satoshi is one hundred millionth of a bitcoin, so even a small gift counts.
Pick a plain-English one about how mining and blocks work.
Show them how a block is found. Understanding is the best gift.

cta: Which would you give? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
description_body: Five Bitcoin gift ideas, from a desk lottery miner to a few sats.
